Home.heroSubtitle: Unique crochet garments and homeware, made in Sweden.
Home.storyTitle: Made by hand, in small batches
Home.storyBody: Every piece is crocheted to order in our Swedish atelier — no factories, no mass production. Just time, care, and a single thread.
Home.madeToOrderBody: Some pieces are made only once you order them. It takes a little longer, but it means nothing is made until it's truly wanted.

About.title: About Âme de Fil
About.intro: Âme de Fil is a small crochet atelier in Sweden. Every piece is made by hand, to order — no factories, no mass production, just time, care, and a single thread.
About.body: Most of what we make is limited by nature: a small batch of yarn, a pattern that only makes sense in certain sizes, a maker who can only crochet so many hours in a day. When something sells out, it's usually gone for good — and when a piece is made to order, it's made only once someone actually wants it.
